boundary: Release 2026.10.13.1 has no successfully verified retained exact-source candidate. A successful technical build would not demonstrate testing on physical iOS/iPadOS and Android devices. Real device install, offline restart/reboot, update, storage-pressure, safe area and text zoom remain pending. Real assistive-technology validation is separately governed by data/accessibility-real-at-validation-v1.json. Production root, Windows signing, provider/accreditation and machine-control authority remain HOLD.
privacyBoundary: Public contract metadata must not include learner names, customer/site identifiers, email addresses, private screenshots, raw process data, backup content, filesystem/user paths or other personal/proprietary evidence. Keep detailed device evidence outside the public repository and reference it only with a non-sensitive review identifier.
